entities.name: John
entities.description: John, one of the two people in this conversation: a married father whose children include his son Kyle, one year old in March 2023, and his daughter Sara. He worked at a mechanical engineering company, was promoted to assistant manager in June 2023 and lost the job in early August 2023 when the company failed, then pursued a hardware role at a tech company. He wants to get into local politics and campaigns on education and infrastructure, ran for office more than once, said in January 2023 that he had failed the military aptitude test and in March 2023 that he had retaken it with good results, graduated with a university degree in late March 2023, lost his dog Max shortly before June 2023, and joined a volunteer fire-fighting brigade in late July 2023 which he later called his true calling.

entities.name: Maria
entities.description: Maria, the other person in this conversation: a volunteer at a homeless shelter she approached about a year before August 2023, who also began volunteering monthly at a dog shelter in June 2023. She practises aerial yoga, joined a gym in June 2023 and a nearby church on 5 May 2023, has a small family, took a solo trip to Spain in 2022, and acquired two dogs in the summer of 2023: Coco around late July and Shadow in August.

entities.name: Kyle

entities.name: Sara
entities.description: John's daughter; the family took a trip in 2022 for her birthday, and the photograph from it is one John keeps as motivation.

entities.name: Rob
entities.description: A colleague of John's who invited him to a beginner's yoga class in February 2023; John started a weekend yoga class with a colleague in early April 2023.

entities.name: David

entities.name: Jean

entities.name: Cindy

entities.name: Maria's aunt
entities.description: Maria's aunt, never named and referred to as 'my aunt' and 'our auntie'. She believed in volunteering and helped Maria's family when they had money problems during Maria's childhood, and she is why Maria started volunteering.

entities.name: Max
entities.description: John's dog, part of the family for ten years until he died shortly before 3 June 2023. John's best memory of him is a camping trip in the summer of 2022 where they hiked and swam, and John was still sharing photographs of him in August 2023.

entities.name: Coco
entities.description: Maria's first dog, a white puppy she got about two weeks before 11 August 2023. She greets Maria when she comes home, and from August 2023 shares the household with Shadow.

entities.name: Shadow
entities.description: Maria's second dog, a black puppy she adopted from a shelter in the week before 13 August 2023. She was learning commands and house training, and gets along with Coco.

entities.name: West County
entities.description: The area John used to live in, which he calls 'my old area' and wants to help improve. It was hit by a bad flood in the week before 7 July 2023 that ruined many homes because the infrastructure was poor.

entities.name: London
entities.description: The city in England Maria visited a few years before 2023; its architecture captivated her and inspired the castle shadow box and castle painting she made for her home.

entities.name: England
entities.description: The country Maria travelled to a few years before 2023, on the trip to London whose castles she was mesmerised by.

entities.name: Spain

entities.name: Oregon
entities.description: Where Maria's family went on a road trip when she was younger, and where she hiked to a waterfall with a bridge over it.

entities.name: the Pacific Northwest
entities.description: The coast John and his family explored on a road trip in 2022, taking in several national parks.

entities.name: California
entities.description: Where John's family took a vacation he remembers for a gorgeous sunset and an evening walk along the shore.

entities.name: Florida

entities.name: the homeless shelter
entities.description: The homeless shelter Maria has volunteered at since about August 2022, which she calls 'the shelter'. She donated her old car to it in December 2022, gave talks there in April 2023, helped organise meals and a fundraiser with a chili cook-off, was given a medal for her work in August 2023, and worked its front desk on 11 August 2023. John's online service group also handed out food and supplies at a homeless shelter at the end of 2022.

entities.name: the fire-fighting brigade
entities.description: The volunteer fire-fighting brigade John joined shortly before 31 July 2023. Its training was intense, its first call-out with him was on 30 July 2023 when the team saved a family from a burning building, and a two-hour donation drive it ran collected canned food, toiletries and clothes and helped pay for a new fire truck.

entities.name: Maria's church
entities.description: The nearby church Maria joined on 5 May 2023 to feel closer to a community and to her faith. Her friends from it went camping with her over the weekend of 10-11 June 2023, had a picnic with her in mid-July 2023, hiked with her, and did community work with her on 4 August 2023.

entities.name: Maria's gym
entities.description: The gym Maria joined in the week before 16 June 2023, where she works on strength and endurance in a welcoming atmosphere and has made friends she went to dinner with on 7 July 2023.

entities.name: John's yoga studio
entities.description: The yoga studio John goes to often, which he describes as having a chill vibe and good instructors. It offers a range of classes including yoga, kickboxing and circuit training, and he had also done weight training there by July 2023.

entities.name: John's mechanical engineering company
entities.description: The mechanical engineering company John worked at. He was promoted to assistant manager there in June 2023 and lost the job shortly before 5 August 2023 when the company failed.

entities.name: the tech company
entities.description: A tech company John said on 5 August 2023 he might have found a job at, which needed his mechanical skills for its hardware team after his engineering job ended.

entities.name: John's service-focused online group
entities.description: The service-focused online group John joined in the week before 1 January 2023, which he later called his virtual support group. Its members met in person, handed out food and supplies at a homeless shelter, ran a toy drive for children, and brainstormed projects for education, mentorship, job training and resume building; in August 2023 John asked his family and friends to join it and advocate for the military.

properties.aliases: the virtual support group, service-focused online group

entities.name: the local dog shelter
entities.description: A local dog shelter Maria began volunteering at once a month from June 2023; she adopted the puppy Shadow from a shelter in August 2023.

entities.name: John's run for local office
entities.description: John's pursuit of local political office, running from wanting to get into local politics in December 2022 through networking, community meetings and policy blogging to running for office again in February 2023 and deciding to run once more in the week before 6 May 2023. Its themes throughout are improving education and infrastructure.

entities.name: John's project to support military veterans
entities.description: John's project supporting military veterans, under way by 20 May 2023 and built around a petition. It included a party on 19 May 2023 where veterans shared their stories, a marching event for veterans' rights at the start of July 2023, a veterans' hospital visit in mid-July 2023 and a 5K charity run in early August 2023.

entities.name: the homeless shelter's fundraiser
entities.description: The homeless shelter fundraiser held at the end of May 2023, for which Maria planned a ring-toss tournament and a chili cook-off and asked John to spread the word and find volunteers; she hoped it would raise enough to cover basic needs for homeless people.

entities.name: John's community food drive
entities.description: The community food drive John started in early February 2023 for people who had lost their jobs, prompted by the effect unemployment was having on his neighbours. It drew an overwhelming response and many volunteers, and Maria offered to help with networking and future events.

entities.name: John's 5K charity run for veterans
entities.description: The 5K charity run John set up in his neighbourhood and held on the weekend of 5-6 August 2023, raising funds for veterans and their families. Organizing it meant getting sponsors, coordinating with the city and spreading the word, and getting sponsors was the hardest part.

entities.name: John's school mentoring
entities.description: The mentoring John took up at a local school by 13 August 2023. His students improved in confidence and skills, and one proudly showed him an essay in the week before 13 August 2023.

entities.name: aerial yoga
entities.description: The aerial yoga Maria took up in December 2022 and still practised in June 2023. She uses it to switch off and focus on her body, and her favourite poses are the upside-down ones.

entities.name: kickboxing
entities.description: The kickboxing John was doing by December 2022, which he said gave him energy; it is also one of the classes his yoga studio offers.

entities.name: yoga
entities.description: The beginner yoga John started as a weekend class in early April 2023, after his colleague Rob invited him in February 2023. It focuses on poses and breathing, helps him relax and improves his flexibility, and had become part of his daily routine by 7 April 2023.

entities.name: camping
entities.description: Camping, which John has done plenty of times and values for being uncomplicated, including the summer 2022 trip with his dog Max that is his best memory of him. Maria has camped a few times and went with friends from her church over the weekend of 10-11 June 2023.

entities.name: hiking
entities.description: Hiking, which recurs for both of them: Maria hikes with friends, hiked to a waterfall in Oregon as a child and hiked with her church group in July 2023, while John hiked with workmates before 25 May 2023 and hikes with his family.
